'''SWCCGinPublic''' (#SWCCGinPublic) was [[Kendall Halman]]'s 21–30 April 2022 campaign for players to play Star Wars CCG in public. 99 players were recognized with an exclusive foil virtual slip.<ref name="pc-swccginpublic">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/the-first-swccginpublic-push-was-a-rousing-success/ The First #SWCCGinPublic Push Was a Rousing Success], starwarsccg.org (19 May 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022214128/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/the-first-swccginpublic-push-was-a-rousing-success.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Dates:''' 21–30 April 2022
* '''Organizer:''' [[Kendall Halman]]
* '''Forum:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=82693 t=82693]

Venues included restaurants, pubs, ballparks, beaches, bowling alleys, hotel lobbies, and local game stores.
